address: Ashcombe Lodge, Broadview Gardens, High Salvington, Worthing, West Sussex, BN13 3BE
lead_profile_text: Existing property looking for higher return
primary_blocker: High monthly holding cost base (~£3,500/month, ~£42,000/year) not yet reduced via mortgage review and business rates switch, so projected STL income does not comfortably cover costs in Year 1

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: Steve's total cost is around £3,500 per month
delay_signals.context: Deal is gated entirely on his cost base rather than readiness — property is already furnished and let-ready, but at current costs the projections only break even in Year 2 and run a loss in Year 1. Zac advised fixing the mortgage and switching to business rates to close the gap.

green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: wants to travel and move abroad, property fully let and hands-off
green_light_signals.context: Lead explicitly wants a fully managed, hands-off solution because he intends to relocate abroad — a genuine want for management rather than just income upside

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Had been pursuing guaranteed rental income; when that proved unavailable to him, pivoted to looking at contract stays specifically for insurance workers
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Gave a second opinion advising him to lower his cost base — via a mortgage review and switching to business rates (est. £1,300/month saving) — rather than pitching harder on income

conversion_gaps.gap: Cost base too high for projected STL income to comfortably cover in Year 1 (shortfall of −£8,842 at current £3,500/month costs, only breaking even in Year 2)
conversion_gaps.evidence: At £3,500/month costs: Year 1 net £33,158 vs ~£42,000 annual costs (−£8,842); Year 2 net £41,448 vs ~£42,000 (−£552, break-even). After an estimated £1,300/month saving (mortgage + business rates), Year 1 flips to +£6,758 surplus.
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Follow up specifically on whether he has spoken to a mortgage broker and investigated the business rates switch — the £1,300/month saving is the whole deal, not the signature

positive_shift_moments.what_caused_shift: Zac giving an advisory second opinion on lowering the cost base (mortgage review + business rates switch) instead of pitching the management service harder on income

friction_moments.what_caused_friction: The guaranteed rent option he had been pursuing turned out to be unavailable to him
friction_moments.lead_response: Pivoted to seeking contract stays specifically for insurance workers as an alternative certainty substitute

zac_language.numbers_framing: Framed the ~£1,300/month saving from a mortgage restructure and business rates switch as the number that converts a Year 1 shortfall (−£8,842) into a surplus (+£6,758), and protects the February trough — the single number the whole deal hinges on
zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: For cost-constrained leads, solve the balance sheet with an honest advisory second opinion rather than selling harder on revenue projections

what_they_needed_most: a certainty substitute for variable STL income (contract/insurance-worker stays)
a concrete plan to close the £1,300/month cost gap
profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: For cost-constrained, certainty-seeking ABROAD leads, lead with an honest cost-coverage breakdown and a concrete cost-reduction plan (mortgage/business rates) before revenue upside — advisory framing outperforms harder income selling for this archetype
